## Problem and change

Explain the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List checks run and any checks not run. For integration changes, include the exact
vLLM version/commit. For performance changes, attach reproducible inputs and raw
metrics, separating simulations from GPU measurements.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and scheduling boundaries are preserved or explicitly explained.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Relevant docs and changelog are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, local results, or personal material included.
